children: Investors need inflation protection considering the anticipated increase in government spending in developed economies, which could push up inflation, Insight Investment's Jessica Shuman says in a note. Inflation-linked bonds have favorable pricing which makes the assets attractive, she says. "While inflation has recently eased in many regions, the underlying fiscal backdrop argues, in our view, for a higher inflation premium over time." (miriam.mukuru@wsj.com)
